features.summary: Pay 1 Focus Point when you Shadow Step to ignore its light requirement; the same Bonus Action also lets you make an Unarmed Strike right after the teleport.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.summary: Magic action in dim light or darkness, 3 Focus Points: for 1 minute you are Invisible, pass through occupied spaces as Difficult Terrain and use Flurry of Blows for free. Ends early if Incapacitated or you end a turn in Bright Light.

summary: A stealthy monk who wields darkness, teleports between shadows and fades from sight.

name: Warrior of the Elements

features.name: Elemental Attunement
features.summary: At the start of your turn, pay 1 Focus Point for 10 minutes of elemental power: Unarmed Strikes reach 10 ft farther and can deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder, and such a hit can force a STR save to move the target 10 ft toward or away.

features.name: Manipulate Elements
features.summary: You know the Elementalism cantrip; WIS is its casting ability.

features.name: Elemental Burst
features.summary: Magic action, 2 Focus Points: a 20-ft-radius burst at a point within 120 ft, of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder. DEX save: three Martial Arts dice on a fail, half on a success.

features.name: Stride of the Elements
features.summary: While Elemental Attunement is on, you have Fly and Swim Speeds equal to your Speed.

features.name: Elemental Epitome
features.summary: While attuned: resist one of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder (switch each turn); Step of the Wind adds 20 ft Speed and hits creatures you move next to for a Martial Arts die (once each per turn); once per turn an Unarmed Strike hit adds a Martial Arts die.

summary: A monk who channels elemental energy into long-reaching strikes and bursts.

name: Warrior of the Mystic Arts

features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: Third-caster on the Sorcerer list with WIS: 2 cantrips (3 at Monk 10) and 3 prepared level 1+ spells at Monk 3, rising to 13 by Monk 20 with slots up to level 4. An Arcane Focus works as your focus; swap one cantrip and one spell each Monk level.

features.name: Mystic Fighting Style
features.summary: When you take the Attack action, one Unarmed Strike can become a casting of a 1-action Sorcerer cantrip.

features.name: Mystic Focus
features.summary: Spend a spell slot (no action) to regain Focus Points equal to its level. On a Short Rest or Uncanny Metabolism, pay Focus Points for one spent slot: level 1 for 2 (Monk 6), 2 for 3 (Monk 7), 3 for 5 (Monk 13), 4 for 6 (Monk 19).

features.name: Focused Strike
features.summary: Whatever the result of your Stunning Strike's save, that target has Disadvantage on saves against your spells until your next turn starts.
features.duration: until the start of your next turn

features.name: Improved Mystic Fighting Style
features.summary: With Flurry of Blows, swap two of its Unarmed Strikes for a 1-action level 1 or 2 Sorcerer spell, cast within that same Bonus Action.

summary: A monk who blends martial discipline with sorcery, trading Focus Points and spell slots back and forth.

name: Warrior of the Open Hand
text: _Master Unarmed Combat Techniques_ Warriors of the Open Hand are masters of unarmed combat. They learn techniques to push and trip their opponents and manipulate their own energy to protect themselves from harm.

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.text:
Whenever you hit a creature with an attack granted by your Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of the following effects on that target.

***Addle.*** The target can’t make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

***Push.*** The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from you.

***Topple.*** The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition.

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.text:
You gain the ability to heal yourself. As a Bonus Action, you can roll your Martial Arts die. You regain a number of Hit Points equal to the number rolled plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1 Hit Point regained).

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Fleet Step
features.text: When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can also use Step of the Wind immediately after that Bonus Action.

features.name: Quivering Palm
features.text:
You gain the ability to set up lethal vibrations in someone’s body. When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you can expend 4 Focus Points to start these imperceptible vibrations, which last for a number of days equal to your Monk level. The vibrations are harmless unless you take an action to end them. Alternatively, when you take the Attack action on your turn, you can forgo one of the attacks to end the vibrations. To end them, you and the target must be on the same plane of existence. When you end them, the target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d12 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

You can have only one creature under the effect of this feature at a time. You can end the vibrations harmlessly (no action required).
features.summary: Starting the vibrations costs 4 Focus Points.

summary: Warriors of the Open Hand are masters of unarmed combat.

name: Oath of Devotion
text:
_Uphold the Ideals of Justice and Order_ The Oath of Devotion binds Paladins to the ideals of justice and order. These Paladins meet the archetype of the knight in shining armor. They hold themselves to the highest standards of conduct, and some—for better or worse—hold the rest of the world to the same standards.

Many who swear this oath are devoted to gods of law and good and use their gods’ tenets as the measure of personal devotion. Others hold angels as their ideals and incorporate images of angelic wings into their helmets or coats of arms.

These paladins share the following tenets:

| • | Let your word be your promise. |
| --- | --- |
| • | Protect the weak and never fear to act. |
| • | Let your honorable deeds be an example. |

features.name: Oath of Devotion Spells
features.text:
The magic of your oath ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Paladin level specified in the Oath of Devotion Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Oath of Devotion Spells**

| Paladin Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 3 | Protection from Evil and Good, Shield of Faith |
| 5 | Aid, Zone of Truth |
| 9 | Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic |
| 13 | Freedom of Movement, |

Guardian of Faith

| 17 | Commune, Flame Strike |
| --- | --- |

features.name: Sacred Weapon
features.text:
When you take the Attack action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to imbue one Melee weapon that you are holding with positive energy. For 10 minutes or until you use this feature again, you add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls you make with that weapon (minimum bonus of +1), and each time you hit with it, you cause it to deal its normal damage type or Radiant damage.

The weapon also emits Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light 20 feet beyond that.

You can end this effect early (no action required). This effect also ends if you aren’t carrying the weapon.
features.summary: Costs one Channel Divinity use.

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.text: You and your allies have Immunity to the Charmed condition while in your Aura of Protection. If a Charmed ally enters the aura, that condition has no effect on that ally while there.

features.name: Smite of Protection
features.text: Your magical smite now radiates protective energy. Whenever you cast _Divine Smite_, you and your allies have Half Cover while in your Aura of Protection. The aura has this benefit until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
features.text:
As a Bonus Action, you can imbue your Aura of Protection with holy power, granting the benefits below for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).

***Holy Ward.*** You have Advantage on any saving throw you are forced to make by a Fiend or an Undead.

***Radiant Damage.*** Whenever an enemy starts its turn in the aura, that creature takes Radiant damage equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus.

***Sunlight.*** The aura is filled with Bright Light that is sunlight.

summary: The Oath of Devotion binds Paladins to the ideals of justice and order.

name: Oath of Glory

features.name: Inspiring Smite
features.summary: Right after casting Divine Smite, spend a Channel Divinity use to split 2d8 + Paladin level Temporary HP among any creatures within 30 ft, you included.

features.name: Oath of Glory Spells
features.summary: Oath spells you always have prepared, gained at Paladin levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17.

features.name: Peerless Athlete
features.summary: Bonus Action, one Channel Divinity use: for 1 hour, Advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics checks and +10 ft on Long and High Jumps.

features.name: Aura of Alacrity
features.summary: +10 ft Speed. An ally who first enters your Aura of Protection on a turn, or starts its turn there, gets +10 ft Speed until its next turn ends.

features.name: Glorious Defense
features.summary: Reaction when you or a creature you see within 10 ft is hit: add your CHA mod (min +1) to its AC against that attack; on a miss, make one weapon attack at the attacker if it's in range. CHA mod uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Living Legend
features.summary: Bonus Action, 10 minutes: Advantage on Charisma checks, a Reaction to reroll a failed save, and once per turn a missed weapon attack can hit instead. Once per Long Rest, or spend a level 5 slot to use it again.

summary: A paladin sworn to heroic deeds who bolsters allies' vigor, speed and defense.

name: Oath of the Ancients

features.name: Nature’s Wrath
features.summary: Magic action, one Channel Divinity use: chosen creatures within 15 ft make a STR save or are Restrained for 1 minute, saving again at the end of each of their turns.

features.name: Oath of the Ancients Spells
features.summary: Oath spells you always have prepared, gained at Paladin levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17.

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.summary: You and allies inside your Aura of Protection resist Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant damage.

features.name: Undying Sentinel
features.summary: Once per Long Rest, when dropped to 0 HP but not killed, stay at 1 HP and then heal 3 × Paladin level. You also stop aging and can't be aged by magic.

features.name: Elder Champion
features.summary: Bonus Action, 1 minute: foes in your aura have Disadvantage on saves against your spells and Channel Divinity, you regain 10 HP at each turn start, and 1-action spells can be cast as a Bonus Action. Once per Long Rest, or spend a level 5 slot.

summary: A paladin who defends life, light and the natural world with primal magic.

name: Oath of the Ebon Blade

features.name: Death Coil
features.summary: Replaces Lay On Hands; you become Undead. A pool of d8s (1 + CHA, min 1) refills on a Long Rest. Bonus Action: spend up to CHA dice (min 1) on a creature you see within 60 ft, CON save for the total as Necrotic (half on success), or heal an Undead target by the total instead.

features.name: Runic Smite
features.summary: Replaces Paladin's Smite: Rune Strike is always prepared and castable once per Long Rest without a slot.

features.name: Oath of the Ebon Blade Spells
features.summary: Always prepared: Death Grip (3), Death and Decay (5), Summon Undead (9), Freedom of Movement (13), Circle of Power (17), plus the spells of your inscribed rune: Blood (Vampiric Blood, Spiritual Weapon, Leeching Strike, Evard's Black Tentacles, Bonestorm), Frost (Chains of Ice, Frostscythe, Remorseless Winter, Ice Storm, Cone of Cold) or Unholy (Scourge Strike, Ray of Enfeeblement, Bestow Curse, Blight, Contagion).

options.name: Blood
options.summary: With the Blood rune: Vampiric Blood (3), Spiritual Weapon (5), Leeching Strike (9), Evard's Black Tentacles (13), Bonestorm (17).

options.name: Frost
options.summary: With the Frost rune: Chains of Ice (3), Frostscythe (5), Remorseless Winter (9), Ice Storm (13), Cone of Cold (17).

options.name: Unholy
options.summary: With the Unholy rune: Scourge Strike (3), Ray of Enfeeblement (5), Bestow Curse (9), Blight (13), Contagion (17).

features.name: Runeforging
features.summary: On a Long Rest, inscribe (or move) one rune on a melee weapon you hold; swap it for another when you gain a level.

options.name: Blood
options.summary: Gain CHA + Paladin level Temporary HP when inscribing it and on each Long Rest, and again whenever you drop an enemy to 0 HP while wielding the weapon.

options.name: Frost
options.summary: Your weapon attacks, Paladin spells and features ignore Cold Resistance; a Light-property extra attack that hits adds 1d4 Cold.

options.name: Unholy
options.summary: Your weapon attacks, Paladin spells and features ignore Necrotic Resistance; with a Heavy weapon, the first creature you hit each turn takes extra Necrotic equal to CHA (min 1).

features.name: Runic Power
features.summary: Right after casting Rune Strike, spend a Channel Divinity use for your rune's effect.

options.name: Blood
options.summary: Heal as much as the Rune Strike's Necrotic damage.

options.name: Frost
options.summary: The target and each enemy in a 10-ft Emanation from it take 2d6 Cold.

options.name: Unholy
options.summary: Curse the target until your next turn ends: its next save takes -1d6, then the curse ends.

features.name: Faithful Steed
features.summary: Your Find Steed mount may be Undead: its Otherworldly Slam deals Necrotic and it gains Ghostly Stride, a once-per-Long-Rest Bonus Action letting it and its rider pass through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain (1d10 Force if a turn ends inside one).

features.name: Aura of Deathly Endurance
features.summary: Inside your Aura of Protection, you and your allies resist Cold, Necrotic and Psychic damage.

features.name: Runic Strikes
features.summary: Replaces Radiant Strikes: melee weapon and Unarmed Strike hits deal an extra 1d8 Necrotic.

features.name: Improved Death Coil
features.summary: Replaces Restoring Touch: Death Coil damage adds CHA (min 1) Necrotic, pass or fail; healing an Undead with it adds your Paladin level.

features.name: Runic Mastery
features.summary: Once per Long Rest, unleash your rune: Blood shields an ally, Frost breathes a cone of cold, Unholy empowers Summon Undead.

options.name: Blood
options.summary: Reaction when a creature you see within 10 ft is hit: reduce its damage by your Paladin level and lose that many HP yourself.

options.name: Frost
options.summary: Swap one attack of your Attack action for a 30-ft Cone: DEX save vs spell DC, 8d6 Cold, half on success.

options.name: Unholy
options.summary: Cast Summon Undead without Concentration for 1 minute; the spirit gets Paladin level + CHA Temporary HP and its first hit each turn adds half your Paladin level (round up) Necrotic.

features.name: Aspect of the Horsemen
features.summary: Bonus Action for 10 minutes: restore Runic Mastery with a level 4 slot, and pick any rune's effect for Runic Power and Runic Mastery. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a level 5 slot.

options.name: Generate Runic Power
options.summary: Spend a level 4 spell slot (no action) to get back a Runic Mastery use.

options.name: Runeforging
options.summary: Runic Power and Runic Mastery can use any rune's effect, not only your inscribed one.

summary: An undead death knight paladin who wields runes, necrotic power and cold against the Scourge.

name: Oath of the Holy

features.name: Oath of the Holy Spells
features.summary: Always prepared: Cure Wounds and Healing Word at Paladin 3; Lesser Restoration and Prayer of Healing at 5; Dispel Magic and Mass Healing Word at 9; Aura of Life and Death Ward at 13; Greater Restoration and Mass Cure Wounds at 17.

features.name: Beacon of Light
features.summary: Magic action, spend a Channel Divinity use on an ally within 60 ft: for 1 minute, when your spells or Lay On Hands heal someone else, that ally heals half as much.

features.name: Lightbringer’s Aura
features.summary: Healing a Bloodied creature in your Aura of Protection with a spell or Lay On Hands adds 1d6 HP.

features.name: Infusion of Light
features.summary: Casting a Radiant-damage spell refills your Lay On Hands pool by the Radiant damage rolled, up to five times your Paladin level.

features.name: Holy Deliverance
features.summary: Bonus Action for 10 minutes: your Aura of Protection sheds sunlight and heals Bloodied allies who start their turn in it by CHA + PB. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a level 5 slot.

options.name: Healing Power
options.summary: An ally that begins its turn Bloodied in the aura heals CHA + PB.

options.name: Sunlight
options.summary: The aura is lit with Bright Light that counts as sunlight.

summary: A paladin devoted to healing and support, channelling the Light to keep allies standing.

name: Oath of the Noble Genies

features.name: Elemental Smite
features.summary: Right after casting Divine Smite, spend a Channel Divinity use for one genie effect: grapple and restrain the target, teleport and turn semi-incorporeal, spread 2d4 Fire to a second creature, or knock foes back and Prone.

options.name: Dao’s Crush
options.summary: The target is Grappled (escape DC = your spell save DC) and Restrained while Grappled.

options.name: Djinni’s Escape
options.summary: Teleport up to 30 ft to a space you see; until the end of your next turn, resist Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing and ignore Grappled, Prone and Restrained.

options.name: Efreeti’s Fury
options.summary: The target takes an extra 2d4 Fire, and another creature you see within 30 ft takes 2d4 Fire too.

options.name: Marid’s Surge
options.summary: The target and chosen creatures in a 10-ft Emanation make a STR save; on a failure they're pushed 15 ft away and knocked Prone.

features.name: Genie Spells
features.summary: Always prepared: Chromatic Orb, Elementalism and Thunderous Smite at Paladin 3; Mirror Image and Phantasmal Force at 5; Fly and Gaseous Form at 9; Conjure Minor Elementals and Summon Elemental at 13; Banishing Smite and Contact Other Plane at 17.

features.name: Genie’s Splendor
features.summary: Unarmored AC is 10 + DEX + CHA, and a Shield still stacks. Gain one of Acrobatics, Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion.

features.name: Aura of Elemental Shielding
features.summary: You and allies in your Aura of Protection resist one of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder; you can switch the type at the start of each of your turns.

features.name: Elemental Rebuke
features.summary: Reaction when an attack roll hits you: halve its damage and the attacker makes a DEX save, taking 2d10 + CHA Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder (half on a success). CHA modifier uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Noble Scion
features.summary: Bonus Action: for 10 minutes gain a 60-ft Fly Speed with hover, and by Reaction turn a failed D20 Test into a success for you or an ally within your Aura of Protection. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a level 5 slot.

options.name: Flight
options.summary: Fly Speed 60 ft; you can hover.

options.name: Minor Wish
options.summary: Reaction when you, or an ally within your Aura of Protection, fail a D20 Test: it becomes a success.

summary: A Paladin sworn to the four genie lords of the Elemental Planes, wielding earth, air, fire and water through their smites.

name: Oath of Vengeance

features.name: Oath of Vengeance Spells
features.summary: Oath spells you always have prepared, gained at Paladin levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17.

features.name: Vow of Enmity
features.summary: As part of the Attack action, spend a Channel Divinity use to mark a creature within 30 ft: Advantage on attacks against it for 1 minute. If it drops to 0 HP, move the mark to another creature within 30 ft for free.

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.summary: When your Opportunity Attack hits, the target's Speed becomes 0 for the turn, and that same Reaction lets you move half your Speed without provoking.

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.summary: Reaction right after your Vow of Enmity target makes an attack roll, hit or miss: make a melee attack against it if it's in range.

features.name: Avenging Angel
features.summary: Bonus Action, 10 minutes: Fly Speed 60 ft with hover, and foes who start a turn in your aura make a WIS save or are Frightened for 1 minute (ends on damage), with attacks against them at Advantage. Once per Long Rest, or spend a level 5 slot.

summary: A paladin sworn to hunt down and punish grievous evil at any cost.

name: Beast Master

features.name: Primal Companion
features.summary: Summon a primal beast (Land, Sea or Sky) that obeys you and acts on your turn. It only Dodges unless you spend a Bonus Action, or give up one of your attacks, to have it act. Revive it within an hour with a Magic action and a spell slot; swap it on a Long Rest.

options.name: Beast of the Land
options.summary: Medium; AC 13 + WIS; HP 5 + 5 × Ranger level (d8 Hit Dice); Speed 40 ft, climb 40 ft; Darkvision 60 ft. Beast's Strike: 1d8 + 2 + WIS; a 20-ft straight run first adds 1d6 and knocks Large or smaller Prone.

options.name: Beast of the Sea
options.summary: Medium; AC 13 + WIS; HP 5 + 5 × Ranger level (d8 Hit Dice); Speed 5 ft, swim 60 ft; Darkvision 90 ft; breathes air and water. Beast's Strike: 1d6 + 2 + WIS and Grapples (escape DC = your spell save DC).

options.name: Beast of the Sky
options.summary: Small; AC 13 + WIS; HP 4 + 4 × Ranger level (d6 Hit Dice); Speed 10 ft, fly 60 ft; Darkvision 60 ft; flying away never provokes. Beast's Strike: 1d4 + 3 + WIS Slashing.

features.name: Exceptional Training
features.summary: When a Bonus Action commands your beast, it can also Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help with its own Bonus Action, and its damaging hits may deal Force damage instead.

features.name: Bestial Fury
features.summary: Your beast makes Beast's Strike twice when commanded to use it, and its first hit each turn on your Hunter's Mark target adds that spell's bonus damage as Force.

features.name: Share Spells
features.summary: A spell you cast on yourself can also affect your beast if it's within 30 ft.

summary: A ranger bonded to a primal beast that fights at their command.

name: Demon Hunter

features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: An Arcane Focus (not a Druidic one) works as your Ranger spellcasting focus.

features.name: Deft Explorer
features.summary: Deft Explorer languages come from the book's chapter 2 tables; Eredun and Nathrezim are suggested.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.summary: Pick a Fighting Style feat, Druidic Warrior, or Void Warrior: two Warlock cantrips (Chill Touch and Mind Sliver suggested) cast as Ranger spells with WIS, one swappable per Ranger level.

options.name: Void Warrior
options.summary: Learn two Warlock cantrips as Ranger spells, WIS casting; swap one for another Warlock cantrip each Ranger level.

features.name: Demon Hunter Spells
features.summary: Always prepared: Throw Glaive (3), Sigil of Flame (5), Metamorphosis (9), Chaos Nova (13), Destructive Wave (17), plus one column of your choice: Devourer (Consume Soul, Misty Step, Soul Reap, Collapsing Star, Steel Wind Strike), Havoc (Fel Rush, Eye Beam, Blink, Fire Shield, Conjure Volley) or Vengeance (Infernal Strike, Fiery Brand, Demon Spikes, Banishment, Sigil of Chains).

options.name: Devourer
options.summary: Consume Soul (3), Misty Step (5), Soul Reap (9), Collapsing Star (13), Steel Wind Strike (17).

options.name: Havoc
options.summary: Fel Rush (3), Eye Beam (5), Blink (9), Fire Shield (13), Conjure Volley (17).

options.name: Vengeance
options.summary: Infernal Strike (3), Fiery Brand (5), Demon Spikes (9), Banishment (13), Sigil of Chains (17).

features.name: Soul Fragments
features.summary: Each Long Rest gives WIS-modifier soul fragments (min 1; +1 at Ranger 13, +2 at 17) that last until the next Long Rest and return to you past 30 ft; save DCs use your spell DC. Reaction when an enemy you see within 30 ft dies: regain one.

options.name: Double Jump
options.summary: One fragment: cast Feather Fall or Jump with no slot.

options.name: Soul Cleave
options.summary: Once per turn in the Attack action, one fragment replaces an attack: creatures in a 10-ft Emanation make a DEX save or take 1d12 + WIS Psychic, and you heal WIS.

options.name: Regaining Soul Fragments
options.summary: Reaction when an enemy you see within 30 ft dies: get back one spent fragment.

features.name: Spectral Sight
features.summary: Blindsight 10 ft.

features.name: Torment
features.summary: Your Hunter's Mark target has Disadvantage attacking anyone but you; once per turn, hitting it with a weapon or Ranger spell adds Aura of Pain (-1d4 on its next save before your next turn ends) or Chaos Strike (+1d8 Fire).

options.name: Aura of Pain
options.summary: Its next save before the end of your next turn takes -1d4.

options.name: Chaos Strike
options.summary: It takes an extra 1d8 Fire.

features.name: Illidari Knowledge
features.summary: New fragment uses: two fragments to cast Counterspell; one fragment and a Bonus Action to cast Throw Glaive with no slot.

options.name: Disrupt
options.summary: Spend two fragments to cast Counterspell when its trigger occurs.

options.name: Warglaive Mastery
options.summary: Bonus Action, one fragment: cast Throw Glaive without a slot.

features.name: Soul Shatter
features.summary: Soul Cleave deals 2d12 + WIS; rolling Initiative with no fragments left gives you one.

features.name: Improved Spectral Sight
features.summary: Replaces Feral Senses: Truesight 30 ft.

summary: A ranger who takes the Burning Legion's fel magic into themselves to hunt demons, fuelled by harvested soul fragments.

name: Fey Wanderer

features.name: Dreadful Strikes
features.summary: Weapon hits can deal an extra 1d4 Psychic damage (1d6 from Ranger level 11); each creature takes it at most once per turn.

features.name: Fey Wanderer Spells
features.summary: Subclass spells always prepared, gained at Ranger levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17. You also get a harmless fey quirk, chosen or rolled on a d6 table.

features.name: Otherworldly Glamour
features.summary: Add your WIS mod (min +1) to Charisma checks, and gain proficiency in Deception, Performance or Persuasion.

features.name: Beguiling Twist
features.summary: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed or Frightened. When you or a creature you see within 120 ft succeeds on one, your Reaction makes another creature within 120 ft save WIS or be Charmed or Frightened (your pick) for 1 minute, saving again each turn end.

features.name: Fey Reinforcements
features.summary: Summon Fey needs no Material component, can be cast once per Long Rest without a slot, and can skip Concentration, lasting 1 minute instead.

features.name: Misty Wanderer
features.summary: Cast Misty Step without a slot WIS mod times (min 1) per Long Rest. Any casting can carry one willing creature within 5 ft, which lands within 5 ft of you.

summary: A ranger touched by fey magic who blends charm with terrifying psychic strikes.

name: Gloom Stalker

features.name: Dread Ambusher
features.summary: +10 ft Speed on your first turn of each combat. Once per turn a weapon hit can add 2d6 Psychic (WIS mod uses, min 1, per Long Rest). Add your WIS mod to Initiative rolls.

features.name: Gloom Stalker Spells
features.summary: Subclass spells always prepared, gained at Ranger levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17.

features.name: Umbral Sight
features.summary: Gain 60 ft Darkvision (+60 ft if you have it). While fully in Darkness, you're Invisible to creatures that use Darkvision to see you.

features.name: Iron Mind
features.summary: Proficiency in Wisdom saves; if you already have it, pick Intelligence or Charisma saves instead.

features.name: Stalker’s Flurry
features.summary: Dread Ambusher's Psychic damage rises to 2d8, and each time you use it you may add Sudden Strike or Mass Fear.

options.name: Sudden Strike
options.summary: Make one more attack with that weapon at another creature within 5 ft of the first target and within range.

options.name: Mass Fear
options.summary: The target and everyone within 10 ft of it save WIS or are Frightened until your next turn starts.
options.duration: until the start of your next turn

features.name: Shadowy Dodge
features.summary: Reaction when a creature rolls to attack you: give the roll Disadvantage, then teleport up to 30 ft to a space you can see, hit or miss.

summary: A ranger who ambushes foes from the dark with shadow magic and dread.

name: Hollow Warden

features.name: Hollow Warden Spells
features.summary: Always prepared: Wrathful Smite at Ranger 3, Alter Self at 5, Phantom Steed at 9, Dominate Beast at 13, Steel Wind Strike at 17.

features.name: Wrath of the Wild
features.summary: Bonus Action, 1 Favored Enemy use: take a ghastly form for 1 minute (ends if Incapacitated or you die, or at will). You gain +1 AC (+2 at Ranger 11), an Opportunity Attack against a creature within 5 ft right after it damages you or an ally, and an aura that makes chosen creatures within 10 ft save (WIS) or be Frightened, on transforming and each turn start.

options.name: Ancient Armor
options.summary: +1 AC while transformed, +2 from Ranger 11.

options.name: Prowling Retribution
options.summary: Right after a creature you see within 5 ft damages you or an ally, make an Opportunity Attack against it.

options.name: Unnerving Aura
options.summary: On transforming and at each of your turn starts, chosen creatures in a 10-ft Emanation make a WIS save or are Frightened until your next turn starts.

features.name: Hungering Might
features.summary: Add WIS (min +1) to CON saves. Once per turn while transformed and Bloodied, an attack hit heals you 1d10 + WIS.

features.name: Rot and Violence
features.summary: While transformed: creatures failing your Unnerving Aura save also can’t heal or take Reactions until your next turn starts, and weapon hits can trigger Sap or Slow on top of the weapon’s other mastery.

options.name: Menacing Aura
options.summary: A failed Unnerving Aura save also blocks healing and Reactions until your next turn starts.

options.name: Strangling Roots
options.summary: A weapon hit can apply Sap or Slow in addition to the weapon’s own (different) mastery property.

features.name: Ancient Might
features.summary: Hits on Frightened creatures add WIS damage. Dropping to 0 HP (not killed) while transformed sets your HP to 2× Ranger level instead, once per Long Rest or by spending a level 4+ slot. Immune to Exhaustion.

options.name: Ominous Strikes
options.summary: An attack hit on a Frightened creature deals extra damage equal to your WIS.

options.name: Persistent Wrath
options.summary: At 0 HP but not killed while transformed, your HP becomes twice your Ranger level. Once per Long Rest; a level 4+ slot restores it.

options.name: Timeless
options.summary: Immunity to the Exhaustion condition.

summary: A Ranger sworn to ancient wild horrors who turns into a monstrous, fear-spreading guardian.

name: Hunter
text: _Protect Nature and People from Destruction_ You stalk prey in the wilds and elsewhere, using your abilities as a Hunter to protect nature and people everywhere from forces that would destroy them.

features.name: Hunter’s Lore
features.text: You can call on the forces of nature to reveal certain strengths and weaknesses of your prey. While a creature is marked by your _Hunter’s Mark_, you know whether that creature has any Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities, and if the creature has any, you know what they are.

features.name: Hunter’s Prey
features.text:
You gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

***Colossus Slayer.*** Your tenacity can wear down even the most resilient foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon, the weapon deals an extra 1d8 damage to the target if it’s missing any of its Hit Points. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

***Horde Breaker.*** Once on each of your turns when you make an attack with a weapon, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target, that is within the weapon’s range, and that you haven’t attacked this turn.

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.text:
You gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

***Escape the Horde.*** Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you.

***Multiattack Defense.*** When a creature hits you with an attack roll, that creature has Disadvantage on all other attack rolls against you this turn.

features.name: Superior Hunter’s Prey
features.text: Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature marked by your _Hunter’s Mark_, you can also deal that spell’s extra damage to a different creature that you can see within 30 feet of the first creature.

features.name: Superior Hunter’s Defense
features.text: When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to give yourself Resistance to that damage and any other damage of the same type until the end of the current turn.

summary: You stalk prey in the wilds and elsewhere, using your abilities as a Hunter to protect nature and people everywhere from forces that would destroy them.

name: Winter Walker

features.name: Frigid Explorer
features.summary: Resist Cold; Cold you deal with weapon attacks, Ranger spells or Ranger features ignores Cold Resistance. Once per turn a weapon hit can add 1d4 Cold (1d6 from Ranger 11).

options.name: Biting Cold
options.summary: Cold you deal with weapon attacks, Ranger spells or Ranger features ignores Resistance.

options.name: Frost Resistance
options.summary: Resistance to Cold damage.

options.name: Polar Strikes
options.summary: Once per turn, a weapon attack hit can deal an extra 1d4 Cold; 1d6 at Ranger 11.

features.name: Hunter’s Rime
features.summary: Casting Hunter's Mark grants 1d10 + Ranger level Temporary HP, and a creature you've marked can't take the Disengage action.

features.name: Winter Walker Spells
features.summary: Always prepared: Ice Knife at Ranger 3, Hold Person at 5, Remove Curse at 9, Ice Storm at 13, Cone of Cold at 17.

features.name: Fortifying Soul
features.summary: Magic action: up to WIS modifier creatures you see (min 1) each heal 1d10 + Ranger level and get Advantage on saves against Frightened for 1 hour. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Chilling Retribution
features.summary: Reaction when a creature's attack roll hits you: it makes a WIS save or is Stunned, with Speed 0, until the end of your next turn. WIS modifier uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Frozen Haunt
features.summary: When you cast Hunter's Mark, take a ghostly snow form for the spell's duration: Cold immunity, 2d4 Cold to chosen creatures in a 15-ft Emanation as it starts and each turn, and you pass through creatures and objects. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a level 4+ slot.

options.name: Frozen Soul
options.summary: Immune to Cold. On entering the form and at the start of each later turn, chosen creatures in a 15-ft Emanation take 2d4 Cold.

options.name: Partially Incorporeal
options.summary: Immune to Grappled, Prone and Restrained. Move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain, taking 1d10 Force if you end a turn inside one; when the form ends you're pushed to the nearest free space.

summary: A hunter of the frozen north, like Icewind Dale, who wears rime as armour and turns the cold on its quarry.

name: Arcane Trickster

features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: Third-caster on the Wizard list with INT: Mage Hand plus 2 more Wizard cantrips (one more at Rogue 10) and 3 prepared level 1 Wizard spells, growing per the Arcane Trickster table up to level 4 slots. Swap a cantrip (not Mage Hand) or a spell each Rogue level; an Arcane Focus works.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.summary: Mage Hand can be cast as a Bonus Action and made Invisible; steer it as a Bonus Action and use it for Sleight of Hand checks.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.summary: While you're Invisible, a creature you target with a spell has Disadvantage on its saves against that spell this turn.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.summary: When you Trip a creature with Cunning Strike, you may also Trip a second creature within 5 ft of your Mage Hand.

features.name: Spell Thief
features.summary: Reaction after a creature's spell targets or includes you: it makes an INT save vs your spell DC. On a fail the spell doesn't affect you, and if it's a level 1+ spell whose level you have slots for, you keep it prepared for 8 hours while the caster can't use it. 1/Long Rest.

summary: A Rogue who adds Intelligence-based Wizard magic and an unseen Mage Hand to a burglar's toolkit.

name: Assassin

features.name: Assassinate
features.summary: Advantage on Initiative. In combat's first round, Advantage on attacks against creatures that haven't acted yet, and a Sneak Attack hit that round adds damage equal to your Rogue level, of the weapon's type.

features.name: Assassin’s Tools
features.summary: Proficiency with, and one each of, the Disguise Kit and Poisoner's Kit.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.summary: After 1 hour of study you can flawlessly copy a person's voice, handwriting or both, and Steady Aim no longer drops your Speed to 0.

features.name: Envenom Weapons
features.summary: Your Cunning Strike Poison also deals 2d6 Poison damage each time the target fails its save, and that damage bypasses Poison Resistance.

features.name: Death Strike
features.summary: Hit with Sneak Attack in combat's first round: the target makes a CON save (DC 8 + DEX + PB) or takes double the attack's damage.

summary: A Rogue built for ambushes, poison and disguise, striking hardest before foes can act.

name: Phantom

features.name: Wails from the Grave
features.summary: Right after dealing Sneak Attack on your turn, a second creature you see within 30 ft of the first takes Necrotic damage from half your Sneak Attack dice (round up). DEX-mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Whispers of the Dead
features.summary: After each Short or Long Rest, gain one skill or tool proficiency you lack; it lasts until you pick another.

features.name: Tokens of the Departed
features.summary: Hold two soul trinkets (3 at Rogue 13, 4 at 17) that return to you past 30 ft; refill to two each Long Rest, or gain one by Reaction when a creature you see dies within 30 ft. While you hold one you have Advantage on Death and CON saves; destroy one to fire a free Wails from the Grave after Sneak Attack, or (Magic action) to cast Augury with CON or question its spirit.

options.name: Death’s Knell
options.summary: After dealing Sneak Attack on your turn, destroy a trinket to use Wails from the Grave without spending a use.

options.name: Life Essence
options.summary: With at least one trinket, Advantage on Death Saving Throws and CON saves.

options.name: Spirit Query
options.summary: Magic action: destroy a trinket to cast Augury without components (CON as the ability), or ask its known spirit one question.

options.name: Gaining Additional Soul Trinkets
options.summary: Reaction when a creature you see within 30 ft dies: gain a trinket, replacing one if at your maximum.

features.name: Voice of Death
features.summary: Cast Speak with Dead once per Short or Long Rest without a slot or components (DEX as the ability), and target a soul trinket in place of a corpse.

features.name: Ghost Walk
features.summary: Bonus Action: spectral form for 10 minutes: Fly 10 ft with hover, attacks against you have Disadvantage, and move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain (1d10 Force if you end a turn inside). Once per Long Rest; destroying a trinket restores it.

features.name: Death’s Friend
features.summary: Wails from the Grave can hit the first creature with its Necrotic damage too, and rolling Initiative with no trinkets gives you one.

options.name: Death’s Lament
options.summary: Wails from the Grave damages both the Sneak Attack target and the second creature.

options.name: Draw of Death
options.summary: On rolling Initiative with no soul trinkets, gain one.

summary: A Rogue tied to death who spreads Sneak Attack as ghostly wails and carries trinkets holding fragments of souls.

name: Scion of the Three

features.name: Bloodthirst
features.summary: Reaction when an enemy you see within 30 ft is left Bloodied but alive by damage: teleport next to it and make one melee attack. INT modifier uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Dread Allegiance
features.summary: Pick one of the Dead Three for a damage Resistance and a cantrip (INT): Bane, Psychic and Minor Illusion; Bhaal, Poison and Blade Ward; Myrkul, Necrotic and Chill Touch. You can switch after a Long Rest.

options.name: Bane
options.summary: Resistance to Psychic; Minor Illusion cantrip.

options.name: Bhaal
options.summary: Resistance to Poison; Blade Ward cantrip.

options.name: Myrkul
options.summary: Resistance to Necrotic; Chill Touch cantrip.

features.name: Strike Fear
features.summary: New Cunning Strike, Terrify (cost 1d6): the target makes a WIS save or is Frightened for 1 minute, giving you Advantage on attacks against it; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

options.name: Terrify
options.summary: Cost 1d6. WIS save or Frightened for 1 minute (repeat the save each turn end); you have Advantage on attacks against it meanwhile.

features.name: Aura of Malevolence
features.summary: When Bloodthirst teleports you, chosen creatures within 10 ft of your start or end space take INT modifier damage of your Dread Allegiance type, ignoring Resistance.

features.name: Dread Incarnate
features.summary: A Short Rest restores one Bloodthirst use, and Sneak Attack dice that roll 1 or 2 count as 3.

options.name: Cutthroat
options.summary: Regain one spent Bloodthirst use on a Short Rest.

options.name: Murderous Intent
options.summary: Treat 1s and 2s on Sneak Attack dice as 3s.

summary: A Rogue empowered, by devotion or by curse, by the Dead Three (Bane, Bhaal and Myrkul), who preys on the wounded and spreads terror.

name: Soulknife

features.name: Psionic Power
features.summary: Psionic Energy Dice: 4d6 at Rogue 3, 6d8 at 5, 8d8 at 9, 8d10 at 11, 10d10 at 13, 12d12 at 17. Regain one on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest. Fuels this subclass's powers, starting with the two below.

options.name: Psi-Bolstered Knack
options.summary: Failed a check with a proficient skill or tool? Roll a Psionic Energy Die and add it; the die is spent only if that makes it succeed.

options.name: Psychic Whispers
options.summary: Magic action: link up to PB creatures you see telepathically (1 mile reach) for hours equal to a Psionic Energy Die roll.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.summary: When you Attack or make an Opportunity Attack with a free hand, form a Simple melee blade: 1d6 Psychic + the attack's modifier, Finesse, Thrown 60/120, Vex mastery (free). After it, a Bonus Action attack with a second blade deals 1d4.

features.name: Soul Blades
features.summary: Two new Psychic Blade powers fueled by Psionic Energy Dice.

options.name: Homing Strikes
options.summary: Missed with a Psychic Blade? Roll a Psionic Energy Die and add it to the attack; the die is spent only if it now hits.

options.name: Psychic Teleportation
options.summary: Bonus Action: spend and roll a Psionic Energy Die, then teleport to an unoccupied space you see up to 10 ft × the roll away.

features.name: Psychic Veil
features.summary: Magic action: become Invisible for 1 hour (dismiss anytime); it ends right after you deal damage or force a save. 1/Long Rest, or spend a Psionic Energy Die to use it again.

features.name: Rend Mind
features.summary: When your Psychic Blades deal Sneak Attack damage, the target makes a WIS save (DC 8 + DEX + PB) or is Stunned for 1 minute, repeating the save at each of its turn ends. 1/Long Rest, or spend 3 Psionic Energy Dice to reuse.

summary: A Rogue whose inner psionic power forms blades of mental energy and fuels telepathy and teleportation.

name: Swashbuckler

features.name: Fancy Footwork
features.summary: After you roll a melee attack against a creature on your turn, it can't make Opportunity Attacks on you until that turn ends.

features.name: Rakish Audacity
features.summary: Add CHA to Initiative rolls. Sneak Attack also works without Advantage when your target is within 5 ft, nobody else is within 5 ft of you, and you lack Disadvantage.

features.name: Panache
features.summary: New Cunning Strike options: Goad (1d6) and Awe (3d6).

options.name: Goad
options.summary: Cost 1d6. Target fails a WIS save: until its next turn ends it has Disadvantage attacking others and can make Opportunity Attacks only against you.

options.name: Awe
options.summary: Cost 3d6. Creatures you choose within 30 ft make a WIS save or are Charmed until your next turn ends.

features.name: Dashing Strikes
features.summary: New Cunning Strike options: Invigorate (2d6) and Parrying Stance (2d6).

options.name: Invigorate
options.summary: Cost 2d6. A creature you see within 30 ft adds 1d6 to its attack rolls and saves until its next turn ends.

options.name: Parrying Stance
options.summary: Cost 2d6. Roll 1d6 and add it to your AC until your next turn starts.

features.name: Master Duelist
features.summary: Right after a Sneak Attack, make another attack on that target if it is within 5 ft and no one else is within 5 ft of you.

summary: A rogue duellist who fights with flair, speed and charm, at their best one-on-one.

name: Thief
text: _Hunt for Treasure as a Classic Adventurer_ A mix of burglar, treasure hunter, and explorer, you are the epitome of an adventurer. In addition to improving your agility and stealth, you gain abilities useful for delving into ruins and getting maximum benefit from the magic items you find there.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.text:
As a Bonus Action, you can do one of the following.

***Sleight of Hand.*** Make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to pick a lock or disarm a trap with Thieves’ Tools or to pick a pocket.

***Use an Object.*** Take the Utilize action, or take the Magic action to use a magic item that requires that action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.text:
You’ve trained to get into especially hard-to-reach places, granting you these benefits.

***Climber.*** You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

***Jumper.*** You can determine your jump distance using your Dexterity rather than your Strength.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.text:
You gain the following Cunning Strike option.

***Stealth Attack (Cost: 1d6).*** If you have the Hide action’s Invisible condition, this attack doesn’t end that condition on you if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total Cover.

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.text:
You’ve learned how to maximize use of magic items, granting you the following benefits.

***Attunement.*** You can attune to up to four magic items at once.

***Charges.*** Whenever you use a magic item property that expends charges, roll 1d6. On a roll of 6, you use the property without expending the charges.

***Scrolls.*** You can use any _Spell Scroll_, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability for the spell. If the spell is a cantrip or a level 1 spell, you can cast it reliably. If the scroll contains a higher-level spell, you must first succeed on an Intelligence (Arcana) check (DC 10 plus the spell’s level). On a successful check, you cast the spell from the scroll. On a failed check, the scroll disintegrates.

features.name: Thief’s Reflexes
features.text: You are adept at laying ambushes and quickly escaping danger. You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. You take your first turn at your normal Initiative and your second turn at your Initiative minus 10.

summary: A mix of burglar, treasure hunter, and explorer, you are the epitome of an adventurer.

name: Aberrant Sorcery

features.name: Psionic Spells
features.summary: Extra always-prepared spells arrive at Sorcerer levels 3, 5, 7 and 9, ranging from Mind Sliver and Detect Thoughts up to Telekinesis and Telepathic Bond.

features.name: Telepathic Speech
features.summary: Bonus Action: link minds with a creature you see within 30 ft for minutes equal to your Sorcerer level, talking telepathically within CHA miles (min 1) in a shared language. A new link ends the old one.

features.name: Psionic Sorcery
features.summary: Cast your level 1+ Psionic Spells with Sorcery Points equal to the spell's level instead of a slot; cast that way they need no Verbal, Somatic or Material components unless the material is consumed or has a cost.

features.name: Psychic Defenses
features.summary: Resistance to Psychic damage; Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed and Frightened.

features.name: Revelation in Flesh
features.summary: Bonus Action: spend 1+ Sorcery Points to transform for 10 minutes, picking one benefit below per point spent.

options.name: Aquatic Adaptation
options.summary: Swim Speed of twice your Speed, and you breathe underwater.

options.name: Glistening Flight
options.summary: Gain a Fly Speed matching your Speed; hovering allowed.

options.name: See the Invisible
options.summary: You see Invisible creatures within 60 ft that lack Total Cover.

options.name: Wormlike Movement
options.summary: Squeeze through 1-inch gaps; spend 5 ft of movement to slip nonmagical restraints or a grapple.

features.name: Warping Implosion
features.summary: Magic action: teleport up to 120 ft to a space you see. Creatures within 30 ft of where you stood make a STR save vs your spell DC: 3d10 Force and pulled toward that spot on a fail, half damage only on a success. 1/Long Rest, or 5 Sorcery Points to reuse.

summary: A Sorcerer touched by alien psionics, with telepathy, mind-bending spells and a body that can mutate at will.

name: Clockwork Sorcery

features.name: Clockwork Spells
features.summary: Extra always-prepared spells arrive at Sorcerer levels 3, 5, 7 and 9, from Aid and Alarm up to Greater Restoration and Wall of Force. Your casting shows a cosmetic sign of order.

features.name: Restore Balance
features.summary: Reaction: a creature you see within 60 ft that would roll a d20 with Advantage or Disadvantage rolls with neither instead. CHA uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Bastion of Law
features.summary: Magic action: spend 1–5 Sorcery Points to ward yourself or a creature within 30 ft with that many d8s. When hurt, the warded creature rolls any number of them to cut the damage. Lasts until your Long Rest or a new ward.

features.name: Trance of Order
features.summary: Bonus Action: for 1 minute, attacks against you can't have Advantage, and your D20 Test rolls of 9 or lower count as 10. 1/Long Rest, or 5 Sorcery Points to reuse.

features.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
features.summary: Magic action: spirits of order fill a 30-ft Cube from you, healing up to 100 HP split as you like, mending objects inside, and ending spells of level 6 or lower on chosen targets. 1/Long Rest, or 7 Sorcery Points to reuse.

summary: A Sorcerer channeling cosmic order to cancel luck, ward allies and impose calm precision.

name: Draconic Sorcery
text: _Breathe the Magic of Dragons_ Your innate magic comes from the gift of a dragon. Perhaps an ancient dragon facing death bequeathed some of its magical power to you or your ancestor. You might have absorbed magic from a site infused with dragons’ power. Or perhaps you handled a treasure taken from a dragon’s hoard that was steeped in draconic power. Or you might have a dragon for an ancestor.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.text:
The magic in your body manifests physical traits of your draconic gift. Your Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and it increases by 1 whenever you gain another Sorcerer level.

Parts of you are also covered by dragon-like scales. While you aren’t wearing armor, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers.

features.name: Draconic Spells
features.text:
When you reach a Sorcerer level specified in the Draconic Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Draconic Spells**

**Sorcerer**

| Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 3 | Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, Dragon’s Breath |
| 5 | Fear, Fly |
| 7 | Arcane Eye, Charm Monster |
| 9 | Legend Lore, Summon Dragon |

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.text:
Your draconic magic has an affinity with a damage type associated with dragons. Choose one of those types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.

You have Resistance to that damage type, and when you cast a spell that deals damage of that type, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.text:
As a Bonus Action, you can cause draconic wings to appear on your back. The wings last for 1 hour or until you dismiss them (no action required). For the duration, you have a Fly Speed of 60 feet.

Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you spend 3 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.

features.name: Dragon Companion
features.text:
You can cast _Summon Dragon_ without a Material component. You can also cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Long Rest.

Whenever you start casting the spell, you can modify it so that it doesn’t require Concentration. If you do so, the spell’s duration becomes 1 minute for that casting.

summary: Your innate magic comes from the gift of a dragon.

name: Shadow Sorcery

features.name: Shadow Spells
features.summary: Always prepared: Bane, Darkness, Inflict Wounds and Pass Without Trace at Sorcerer 3; Hunger of Hadar and Nondetection at 5; Greater Invisibility and Phantasmal Killer at 7; Contagion and Creation at 9.

features.name: Power of Shadow
features.summary: Darkvision 120 ft and Blindsight 10 ft, and you see through Darkness your own spells make. Once per Long Rest, when you would drop to 0 HP without dying, a CHA save (DC 5 + damage) leaves you at CHA + Sorcerer level HP.

options.name: Eyes of the Dark
options.summary: Darkvision 120 ft, Blindsight 10 ft; your spells’ Darkness doesn’t block your sight.

options.name: Strength of the Grave
options.summary: On dropping to 0 HP (not killed), CHA save DC 5 + damage taken; success sets your HP to CHA + Sorcerer level. Once per Long Rest after a success.

features.name: Beasts of Ill Omen
features.summary: Spend 3 Sorcery Points: cast Summon Beast as a Bonus Action with no slot, preparation or Material components; it looks like shadow, and enemies within 5 ft of it have Disadvantage on saves against your spells. You may drop Concentration, making it last 1 minute and end if you recast.

features.name: Shadow Walk
features.summary: Bonus Action in Dim Light or Darkness: teleport up to 120 ft to a space you see that is also dim or dark.

features.name: Umbral Form
features.summary: When you use Innate Sorcery, become shadow while it lasts: move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain (1d10 Force if you end a turn inside) and resist all damage but Force and Radiant. Once per Long Rest, or spend 6 Sorcery Points.

options.name: Incorporeal Movement
options.summary: Pass through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain; ending your turn inside one deals 1d10 Force to you.

options.name: Shadow Resilience
options.summary: Resistance to every damage type except Force and Radiant.

summary: A Sorcerer whose magic springs from the Shadowfell, seeing through darkness, cheating death and calling shadow hounds.

name: Spellfire Sorcery

features.name: Spellfire Burst
features.summary: Once per turn, when you spend Sorcery Points in a Magic action or Bonus Action, a creature within 30 ft (or you) gains 1d4 + CHA Temporary HP, or a creature within 30 ft takes 1d4 Fire or Radiant.

options.name: Bolstering Flames
options.summary: You or a creature you see within 30 ft gains 1d4 + CHA Temporary HP.

options.name: Radiant Fire
options.summary: A creature you see within 30 ft takes 1d4 Fire or Radiant, your pick.

features.name: Spellfire Spells
features.summary: Always prepared: Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration and Scorching Ray at Sorcerer 3; Aura of Vitality and Dispel Magic at 5; Fire Shield and Wall of Fire at 7; Greater Restoration and Flame Strike at 9.

features.name: Absorb Spells
features.summary: Counterspell is always prepared, and you regain 1d4 Sorcery Points whenever a target fails its save against your Counterspell.

features.name: Honed Spellfire
features.summary: Bolstering Flames adds your Sorcerer level to its Temporary HP, and Radiant Fire deals 1d8.

features.name: Crown of Spellfire
features.summary: Once per Long Rest (or by spending 5 Sorcery Points), Innate Sorcery also grants a 60-ft Fly Speed with hover, lets you burn up to CHA Hit Point Dice once per turn to cut a hit's damage, and turns half-damage saves into no damage on a success and half on a failure.

options.name: Burning Life Force
options.summary: Once per turn when an attack roll hits you, spend up to CHA modifier Hit Point Dice (min 1) and subtract their roll from the damage.

options.name: Flight
options.summary: Fly Speed 60 ft; you can hover.

options.name: Spell Avoidance
options.summary: Against a spell or magical effect whose save halves damage, take none on a success and half on a failure; not while Incapacitated.

summary: A Sorcerer who channels spellfire, the raw radiance of the Weave, to heal friends, burn foes and drink in hostile magic.

name: Wild Magic Sorcery

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.summary: Once per turn after casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, you may roll a d20; a 20 means a roll on the surge table. A spell a surge creates can't take Metamagic.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.summary: Before a D20 Test, grant yourself Advantage on it. It comes back on a Long Rest or when you next cast a Sorcerer spell with a slot, which also triggers a surge roll.

uses.restore: casting a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot (also rolls a surge)

features.name: Bend Luck
features.summary: Reaction right after another creature you see rolls a D20 Test: spend 1 Sorcery Point and roll 1d4 to add to or subtract from its roll.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.summary: Surge table rolls are made twice; you pick which result applies.

features.name: Tamed Surge
features.summary: Right after casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, choose any surge table effect except the last row instead of rolling (roll any dice it calls for). 1/Long Rest.

summary: A Sorcerer whose chaotic inner magic can erupt in random surges and bend luck.

name: Archfey Patron

features.name: Archfey Spells
features.summary: Always-prepared patron spells at Warlock levels 3, 5, 7 and 9 (fey charms, teleports and illusions); they don't count against your prepared spells.

features.name: Steps of the Fey
features.summary: Cast Misty Step with no slot CHA times (min 1) per Long Rest. Each casting of it can add one step effect: temp HP to you or an ally, or a WIS save that makes nearby foes worse at attacking anyone but you.

options.name: Refreshing Step
options.summary: Right after the teleport, you or a creature you see within 10 ft gets 1d10 temp HP.

options.name: Taunting Step
options.summary: Foes within 5 ft of where you left make a WIS save or attack others than you at Disadvantage until your next turn starts.
options.duration: until the start of your next turn

features.name: Misty Escape
features.summary: Misty Step becomes a Reaction you can take when you're damaged. Two more step effects join Steps of the Fey: brief invisibility, or a psychic burst.

options.name: Disappearing Step
options.summary: You turn Invisible until your next turn starts, ending early once you attack, deal damage or cast.
options.duration: until the start of your next turn

options.name: Dreadful Step
options.summary: Creatures within 5 ft of your start or end point (pick one) make a WIS save or take 2d10 psychic.

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.summary: Immune to Charmed. Reaction when a seen attacker hits you: halve the damage, and on a failed WIS save it takes psychic damage equal to what you took. 1/Long Rest, or spend a Pact slot to reuse.

features.name: Bewitching Magic
features.summary: After casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell with an action and a slot, you also get a free Misty Step within that same action, no slot needed.

summary: A warlock bound to a fey power, blinking around the battlefield with free Misty Steps that carry extra tricks.

name: Celestial Patron

features.name: Celestial Spells
features.summary: Always-prepared patron spells at Warlock levels 3, 5, 7 and 9 (healing, light and radiant magic); they don't count against your prepared spells.

features.name: Healing Light
features.summary: A pool of d6s equal to 1 + Warlock level, refilled on a Long Rest. Bonus Action: spend up to CHA dice (min 1) to heal yourself or a creature you see within 60 ft by their total.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.summary: Resistance to Radiant. Once per turn, a spell of yours dealing Radiant or Fire damage adds your CHA to the damage against one target.

features.name: Celestial Resilience
features.summary: Each rest (Short or Long) and each Magical Cunning gives you temp HP of Warlock level + CHA; up to five creatures you see get half your level + CHA.

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.summary: When you or an ally within 60 ft is about to roll a death save, they instead heal half their max HP and may stand up; foes you pick within 30 ft of them take 2d8 + CHA radiant and are Blinded this turn. 1/Long Rest.
features.duration: until the end of the current turn

summary: A warlock serving a heavenly power, mixing pact magic with healing and radiant fire.

name: Fiend Patron
text: _Make a Deal with the Lower Planes_ Your pact draws on the Lower Planes, the realms of perdition. You might forge a bargain with a demon lord, an archdevil, or another fiend that is especially mighty. That patron’s aims are evil—the corruption or destruction of all things, ultimately including you—and your path is defined by the extent to which you strive against those aims.

features.name: Dark One’s Blessing
features.text: When you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Warlock level (minimum of 1 Temporary Hit Point). You also gain this benefit if someone else reduces an enemy within 10 feet of you to 0 Hit Points.

features.name: Fiend Spells
features.text:
The magic of your patron ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Warlock level specified in the Fiend Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Fiend Spells**

| Warlock Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 3 | Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion |
| 5 | Fireball, Stinking Cloud |
| 7 | Fire Shield, Wall of Fire |
| 9 | Geas, Insect Plague |

features.name: Dark One’s Own Luck
features.text:
You can call on your fiendish patron to alter fate in your favor. When you make an ability check or a saving throw, you can use this feature to add 1d10 to your roll. You can do so after seeing the roll but before any of the roll’s effects occur.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), but you can use it no more than once per roll. You regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.text: Choose one damage type, other than Force, whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest. You have Resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one with this feature.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.text:
Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can try to instantly transport the target through the Lower Planes. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC, or the target disappears and hurtles through a nightmare landscape. The target takes 8d10 Psychic damage if it isn’t a Fiend, and it has the Incapacitated condition until the end of your next turn, when it returns to the space it previously occupied or the nearest unoccupied space.

Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you expend a Pact Magic spell slot (no action required) to restore your use of it.
features.duration: until the end of your next turn

summary: Your pact draws on the Lower Planes, the realms of perdition.

name: Great Old One Patron

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.summary: Bonus Action: open a two-way telepathic link with a creature you see within 30 ft. Works up to CHA miles apart (min 1) for minutes equal to your Warlock level; a shared language is needed. A new link ends the old one.

features.name: Great Old One Spells
features.summary: Always-prepared patron spells at Warlock levels 3, 5, 7 and 9 (mind-reading, madness and aberrant magic); they don't count against your prepared spells.

features.name: Psychic Spells
features.summary: Your damaging Warlock spells may deal Psychic instead of their normal type, and your Warlock Enchantment and Illusion spells need no Verbal or Somatic components.

features.name: Clairvoyant Combatant
features.summary: When you make an Awakened Mind link, the target can be forced to make a WIS save; if it fails, while the link lasts it attacks you at Disadvantage and you attack it with Advantage. 1/Short or Long Rest, or spend a Pact slot to reuse.

features.name: Eldritch Hex
features.summary: Hex is always prepared for you. Its target also has Disadvantage on saves of the ability you picked for the curse.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.summary: No one can read your mind unless you let them. Resistance to Psychic, and anyone who deals you psychic damage takes the same amount you took.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.summary: Summon Aberration can skip Concentration (lasting 1 minute); the summon then starts with temp HP of Warlock level + CHA. Once per turn its hit on a hexed creature adds Hex's extra psychic damage.

summary: A warlock touched by an alien elder being, wielding telepathy, psychic damage and mind-warping curses.

name: Undead Patron

features.name: Form of Dread
features.summary: Bonus Action: transform for 1 minute (ends if Incapacitated or at will), CHA-mod times (min 1) per Long Rest. Gain 1d10 + Warlock level Temp HP and Frightened immunity; once per turn an attack hit can force a WIS save or Frightened until your next turn ends.

options.name: Facsimile of Life
options.summary: Gain Temporary HP equal to 1d10 + your Warlock level.

options.name: Fearless Form
options.summary: Immunity to Frightened while transformed; transforming ends it.

options.name: Frightful Avatar
options.summary: Once per turn on an attack hit, the target makes a WIS save or is Frightened until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Undead Spells
features.summary: Always prepared: Bane, Blindness/Deafness, Phantasmal Force and Ray of Sickness at Warlock 3; Speak with Dead and Summon Undead at 5; Greater Invisibility and Phantasmal Killer at 7; Antilife Shell and Cloudkill at 9.

features.name: Grave Touched
features.summary: Your Necrotic damage ignores Necrotic Resistance, and once per turn a damaging spell can switch to Necrotic. In Form of Dread, once per turn a Necrotic hit rolls one extra damage die. No sleep, and no Exhaustion from thirst, hunger or suffocation.

options.name: Arcane Necrosis
options.summary: Necrotic dealt by your attacks, Warlock spells or Warlock features ignores Necrotic Resistance; once per turn change a damaging spell’s type to Necrotic.

options.name: Dreaded Necrosis
options.summary: Once per turn in Form of Dread, a hit dealing Necrotic damage rolls one more damage die.

options.name: Undead Endurance
options.summary: No Exhaustion from dehydration, malnutrition or suffocation; you don’t sleep and can’t be magically slept.

features.name: Necrotic Husk
features.summary: Resistance to Necrotic (Immunity in Form of Dread). Once per Short or Long Rest, on dropping to 0 HP without dying, blast chosen creatures within 30 ft (CON save, 2d10 + CHA Necrotic, half on success), return to 2× Warlock level HP and gain 1 Exhaustion.

options.name: Necrotic Resilience
options.summary: Resistance to Necrotic damage; Immunity while in Form of Dread.

options.name: Unholy Resuscitation
options.summary: At 0 HP but not killed: chosen creatures in a 30-ft Emanation make a CON save, taking 2d10 + CHA Necrotic (half on success); your HP becomes 2× Warlock level and you gain 1 Exhaustion. Once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Superior Dread
features.summary: In Form of Dread: resist Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing; fly at your Speed with hover and pass through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain (1d10 Force if you end inside); cast Warlock Conjuration and Necromancy spells with no V, S or non-costly M components.

options.name: Dread Resistance
options.summary: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.

options.name: Ghostly Flight
options.summary: Fly Speed equal to your Speed with hover; move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain, taking 1d10 Force if you end a turn inside one.

options.name: Profane Casting
options.summary: Warlock Conjuration and Necromancy spells need no Verbal, Somatic or Material components, except costly or consumed ones.

summary: A Warlock bound to a lich, vampire or other deathless power, who takes on a terrifying form of undeath.

name: Vestige Patron

features.name: Vestige Companion
features.summary: A Small vestige (Celestial, Fiend or Undead, re-chosen each Long Rest) obeys you and acts on your turn, only Dodging unless you spend a Bonus Action or one of your attacks. AC 13 + CHA, HP 4 + 4 × Warlock level, hover 30 ft; Vestige's Strike (spell attack, reach 5 or range 60) deals 1d6 + 3 + CHA. Remake it with a 1-minute ceremony after it drops; dismiss or recall it as a Magic action.

options.name: Celestial
options.summary: Strike deals Radiant; resists Radiant. Healing Touch (Bonus Action, 1/day): a touched creature heals 2d8 + CHA and ends Blinded, Deafened or Poisoned.

options.name: Fiend
options.summary: Strike deals Fire; resists Fire. Fiendish Swap (Bonus Action, 1/day): you and the vestige trade places by teleport if within 60 ft of each other.

options.name: Undead
options.summary: Strike deals Necrotic; resists Necrotic. Cursed Invocation (Bonus Action, 1/day): for 1 minute a creature within 30 ft of it has Disadvantage attacking you or the vestige.

features.name: Vestige Spells
features.summary: Pick the Life, Light, Trickery or War Domain: its domain spells count as Warlock spells and are always prepared once your Warlock level reaches each row's Cleric level.

features.name: Vestige Power
features.summary: Divine Power now recharges on any Short or Long Rest, and whenever you use Magical Cunning. Within 30 ft of your vestige, you share its damage Resistance.

features.name: Vestige Recovery
features.summary: Reaction and a Pact Magic slot when your vestige would hit 0 HP: it returns to full HP and teleports to a space you see within 30 ft of it. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Semblance of Life
features.summary: Magic action, vestige within 90 ft: for 1 hour it takes the Summon Celestial, Fiend or Undead spirit stat block matching its type, at spell level half your Warlock level, keeping its HP, Hit Dice, personality and Divine Power. It gains the spirit's HP as Temporary HP; the form ends when they run out. Once per Long Rest.

summary: A warlock bound to the fading remnant of a forgotten god, which fights at their side as a floating vestige.

name: Abjurer

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.summary: Two Abjuration Wizard spells of level 2 or lower go into your spellbook free. Each time you unlock a new spell slot level, add one more Abjuration spell you can cast, also free.

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.summary: Casting an Abjuration spell with a slot can raise a ward on you (once per Long Rest; it lasts until then) with max HP 2 × Wizard level + INT. It soaks your damage first. Later Abjuration casts restore 2 × slot level; a Bonus Action and a slot restores the same.

features.name: Projected Ward
features.summary: Reaction when a creature you see within 30 ft takes damage: your Arcane Ward absorbs it instead; leftover damage goes to that creature.

features.name: Spell Breaker
features.summary: Counterspell and Dispel Magic are always prepared. Dispel Magic can be a Bonus Action and adds PB to its check. If either fails to stop a spell, the slot comes back.

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.summary: Advantage on saves against spells, and Resistance to damage dealt by spells.

summary: A wizard of protective magic who shields themselves and allies with an arcane ward and breaks hostile spells.

name: Bladesinger

features.name: Bladesong
features.summary: Bonus Action, with no armor or Shield: for 1 minute add INT to AC (min +1), gain +10 ft Speed and Advantage on Acrobatics, attack with INT, and add INT to Concentration saves. Ends if you're Incapacitated, don armor or a Shield, or attack two-handed. INT modifier uses (min 1) per Long Rest; Arcane Recovery restores one.

options.name: Agility
options.summary: +INT to AC (min +1), +10 ft Speed and Advantage on DEX (Acrobatics) checks.

options.name: Bladework
options.summary: Use INT for attack and damage rolls with weapons you're proficient with.

options.name: Focus
options.summary: Add INT to CON saves to keep Concentration.

features.name: Training in War and Song
features.summary: Proficiency with Martial Melee weapons lacking Two-Handed and Heavy, which can serve as your spellcasting focus. Gain one of Acrobatics, Athletics, Performance or Persuasion.

grants.value: Martial Melee weapons without the Two-Handed or Heavy property

features.name: Extra Attack
features.summary: Attack twice with the Attack action, and one of those attacks can be swapped for a Wizard cantrip that takes an action.

features.name: Song of Defense
features.summary: Reaction when you take damage during Bladesong: spend a spell slot to cut the damage by five times its level.

features.name: Song of Victory
features.summary: After casting a spell with a casting time of an action, make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

summary: A Wizard of an elven tradition that weaves swordplay and dance into spellcasting.

name: Conjurer

features.name: Benign Transposition
features.summary: Bonus Action: teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space you see, or trade places with a willing Medium or smaller creature there. INT modifier uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Conjuration Savant
features.summary: Two Conjuration Wizard spells of level 2 or lower go into your spellbook free. Each time you unlock a new spell slot level, add one more Conjuration spell you can cast, also free.

features.name: Distant Transposition
features.summary: Benign Transposition reaches 60 ft, and a level 3+ spell slot (no action) restores one of its uses.

features.name: Durable Summons
features.summary: A creature you summon or create with a slot-cast Conjuration spell arrives with Temporary HP of 2 × your Wizard level, and while those last it resists all damage but Force, Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant.

features.name: Focused Conjuration
features.summary: Your Concentration on a Conjuration spell holds no matter how much damage you take.

features.name: Splintered Summons
features.summary: A slot-cast Conjuration spell that calls a spirit with its own stat block (Summon Aberration and the like) can call two of them, each with half the HP; both vanish if Concentration ends. Once per Long Rest; a level 5+ slot restores it.

summary: A wizard who treats distance as optional, teleporting at will and calling up creatures to fight for them.

name: Diviner

features.name: Divination Savant
features.summary: Two Divination Wizard spells of level 2 or lower go into your spellbook free. Each time you unlock a new spell slot level, add one more Divination spell you can cast, also free.

features.name: Portent
features.summary: After each Long Rest roll 2d20 and note them. Before any D20 Test by you or a creature you see, you may swap its roll for one noted result (each used once, max one swap per turn). Unused ones vanish at your next Long Rest.

features.name: Expert Divination
features.summary: Casting a Divination spell with a slot of level 2+ refunds one expended slot of a lower level (level 5 at most).

features.name: The Third Eye
features.summary: Bonus Action: take one sight benefit until your next rest begins. 1/Short or Long Rest.

options.name: Darkvision
options.summary: Darkvision out to 120 ft.

options.name: Greater Comprehension
options.summary: You can read every language.

options.name: See Invisibility
options.summary: Cast See Invisibility with no slot.

features.name: Greater Portent
features.summary: Portent now gives three foretold d20s instead of two.

summary: A wizard who reads the future, swapping in foreseen d20 rolls and casting divinations cheaply.

name: Enchanter

features.name: Enchanting Conversationalist
features.summary: Gain Deception, Intimidation or Persuasion, and add your INT modifier (min +1) to checks with it.

features.name: Enchantment Savant
features.summary: Two Enchantment Wizard spells of level 2 or lower go into your spellbook free. Each time you unlock a new spell slot level, add one more Enchantment spell you can cast, also free.

features.name: Hypnotic Presence
features.summary: Magic action: a creature within 10 ft that sees or hears you makes a WIS save or is Charmed, Incapacitated and at Speed 0 for 1 minute; it ends if it takes damage, moves over 10 ft off or loses sight and sound of you. INT modifier uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Split Enchantment
features.summary: Cast a slot-cast Enchantment spell that gains targets when upcast (like Charm Person) as if one level higher. INT modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Instinctive Charm
features.summary: Reaction when a creature you see within 30 ft hits you: it makes a WIS save or misses, turning the same roll on another creature in its range that you pick. Once per Long Rest; casting a slot-cast Enchantment spell restores it.

features.name: Alter Memories
features.summary: One creature you Charm with a slot-cast Enchantment spell doesn't know it's Charmed. Once during the spell, a Magic action forces an INT save: on a fail it forgets up to 1 + INT modifier hours (min 1), no longer than the spell's duration.

summary: A wizard who sways minds, charming, entrancing and rewriting the memories of others.

name: Evoker
text: _Create Explosive Elemental Effects_ Your studies focus on magic that creates powerful elemental effects such as bitter cold, searing flame, rolling thunder, crackling lightning, and burning acid.
