Some Evokers find employment in military forces, serving as artillery to blast armies from afar. Others use their power to protect others, while some seek their own gain.

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.text:
Choose two Wizard spells from the Evocation school, each of which must be no higher than level 2, and add them to your spellbook for free.

In addition, whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one Wizard spell from the Evocation school to your spellbook for free. The chosen spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.text: Your damaging cantrips affect even creatures that avoid the brunt of the effect. When you cast a cantrip at a creature and you miss with the attack roll or the target succeeds on a saving throw against the cantrip, the target takes half the cantrip’s damage (if any) but suffers no additional effect from the cantrip.

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.text: You can create pockets of relative safety within the effects of your evocations. When you cast an Evocation spell that affects other creatures that you can see, you can choose a number of them equal to 1 plus the spell’s level. The chosen creatures automatically succeed on their saving throws against the spell, and they take no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.text: Whenever you cast a Wizard spell from the Evocation school, you can add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

features.name: Overchannel
features.text:
You can increase the power of your spells. When you cast a Wizard spell with a spell slot of levels 1–5 that deals damage, you can deal maximum damage with that spell on the turn you cast it.

The first time you do so, you suffer no adverse effect. If you use this feature again before you finish a Long Rest, you take 2d12 Necrotic damage for each level of the spell slot immediately after you cast it. This damage ignores Resistance and Immunity.

Each time you use this feature again before finishing a Long Rest, the Necrotic damage per spell level increases by 1d12.

summary: Your studies focus on magic that creates powerful elemental effects such as bitter cold, searing flame, rolling thunder, crackling lightning, and burning acid.

name: Illusionist

features.name: Illusion Savant
features.summary: Two Illusion Wizard spells of level 2 or lower go into your spellbook free. Each time you unlock a new spell slot level, add one more Illusion spell you can cast, also free.

features.name: Improved Illusions
features.summary: Your Illusion spells skip Verbal components, and those with 10+ ft range reach 60 ft farther. Learn Minor Illusion free (or another Wizard cantrip if known); it can make sound and image together and be cast as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Phantasmal Creatures
features.summary: Summon Beast and Summon Fey are always prepared and can be cast as Illusions. Each Illusion version can be cast once per Long Rest with no slot, but the summon has half HP.

features.name: Illusory Self
features.summary: Reaction when an attack roll hits you: a decoy of you steps in and the attack misses. 1/Short or Long Rest, or spend a level 2+ slot to reuse.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.summary: While an Illusion spell you cast with a slot lasts, a Bonus Action makes one inanimate, nonmagical object in it real for 1 minute; it can't deal damage or impose conditions.

summary: A wizard of deception whose illusions grow stronger, summon spectral beasts and finally turn partly real.

name: Necromancer

features.name: Necromancy Savant
features.summary: Two Necromancy Wizard spells of level 2 or lower go into your spellbook free. Each time you unlock a new spell slot level, add one more Necromancy spell you can cast, also free.

features.name: Necromancy Spellbook
features.summary: Resistance to Necrotic damage. Find Familiar enters your spellbook with Skeleton, Zombie or undead forms, and you can give up one attack of the Attack action so it attacks with its Reaction. Slot-cast Necromancy spells heal an Undead you see within 60 ft by slot level + Wizard level.

options.name: Necrotic Resistance
options.summary: You resist Necrotic damage.

options.name: Undead Familiar
options.summary: Your familiar can be a Skeleton or Zombie, or a normal form of Undead type; trade one of your attacks to let it attack with its Reaction.

options.name: Undead Vitality
options.summary: When you cast a Necromancy spell with a slot, an Undead you see within 60 ft regains HP equal to the slot level + your Wizard level.

features.name: Grave Power
features.summary: While holding your spellbook: Arcane Recovery also lowers your Exhaustion by 1, and your Wizard spells and features ignore Necrotic Resistance.

options.name: Grave Resilience
options.summary: Arcane Recovery removes 1 Exhaustion level.

options.name: Overwhelming Necrosis
options.summary: Necrotic damage from your Wizard spells and features ignores Resistance.

features.name: Undead Thralls
features.summary: Animate Dead is always prepared; cast it free once per Long Rest, and any casting can go one level higher. Holding your spellbook, undead your Necromancy creates gain INT + half Wizard level HP, and your undead within 60 ft add INT (min 1) Necrotic to hits.

options.name: Undead Fortitude
options.summary: Undead you create or summon with Necromancy get max and current HP raised by INT modifier + half your Wizard level.

options.name: Withering Strike
options.summary: Your controlled Undead within 60 ft deal extra Necrotic equal to your INT modifier (min 1) when they hit.

features.name: Harvest Undead
features.summary: Reaction right after damage leaves you Bloodied but above 0 HP: drop an Undead you control and see to 0 HP and regain HP equal to your Wizard level.

features.name: Death’s Master
features.summary: Holding your spellbook: once per Long Rest, a Bonus Action grants your Necromancy-made Undead within 60 ft Temporary HP equal to your Wizard level. An Undead you see dropping to 0 HP can burst for d6s equal to half its unspent Hit Dice (min 1d6) of Necrotic in a 10-ft Emanation (DEX save for half; failures lose Reactions); one you don't control costs a Reaction and a level 5+ slot.

options.name: Bolster Undead
options.summary: Bonus Action: chosen Undead you made or summoned with Necromancy within 60 ft each gain Temporary HP equal to your Wizard level. Once per Long Rest.

options.name: Extinguish Undead
options.summary: An Undead you see at 0 HP explodes: d6s equal to half its unspent Hit Dice (round up, min 1) of Necrotic to each creature in a 10-ft Emanation, DEX save for half; those failing can't take Reactions until their next turn starts.

summary: A wizard who studies life, death and undeath, raising and empowering undead servants from a dread spellbook.

name: Transmuter

features.name: Transmutation Savant
features.summary: Two Transmutation Wizard spells of level 2 or lower go into your spellbook free. Each time you unlock a new spell slot level, add one more Transmutation spell you can cast, also free.

features.name: Transmuter’s Stone
features.summary: After a Long Rest, make a Tiny stone (usable as your Wizard focus) that gives its holder CON save proficiency plus one benefit: Darkvision 60 ft (or +60 ft), Resistance to one of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison or Thunder, or +10 ft Speed. A slot-cast Transmutation spell lets you switch the benefit.

options.name: Darkvision
options.summary: Darkvision 60 ft, or +60 ft to existing Darkvision.

options.name: Resistance
options.summary: Resistance to your pick of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison or Thunder.

options.name: Speed
options.summary: Speed +10 ft.

features.name: Wondrous Alteration
features.summary: Alter Self is always prepared; cast it free once per Long Rest. Under it, Aquatic Adaptation lets you Dash as a Bonus Action underwater, Change Appearance gives Advantage on Charisma (Deception), and Natural Weapons deal 2d6 and give Advantage on Concentration saves.

features.name: Empowered Transmutation
features.summary: Cast a slot-cast Transmutation spell that makes no attack roll and forces no save (Fly, Magic Weapon…) as if one level higher. INT modifier uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Potent Stone
features.summary: Your stone holds two benefits (Resistance can be taken twice for different types), both switchable on a slot-cast Transmutation spell. New benefits: Mighty Build (Advantage on STR saves, carry as one size larger) and Tremorsense 30 ft.

options.name: Mighty Build
options.summary: Advantage on STR saves; carrying capacity as one size larger.

options.name: Tremorsense
options.summary: Tremorsense 30 ft.

features.name: Shape-Shifter
features.summary: Polymorph is always prepared; cast it free once per Long Rest. Once per Long Rest, when you Polymorph yourself, keep your mind, speech, INT/WIS/CHA, proficiencies, class features and feats, and cast Transmutation spells without costly or consumed Material components.

features.name: Master Transmuter
features.summary: Magic action, holding your stone: spend it for one effect, after which it turns to dust unless you also spend a level 7+ slot.

options.name: Major Transformation
options.summary: Over 10 minutes of handling, turn a nonmagical object up to a 10-ft Cube (or eight joined 5-ft Cubes) into a different mundane object of about the same size and mass, worth no more.

options.name: Panacea
options.summary: A touched creature heals half its HP maximum and is freed of magical diseases, curses (cursed-item Attunement included), Poisoned and Petrified.

options.name: Restore Life
options.summary: Cast Raise Dead with no slot, the stone standing in for its Material components.

options.name: Restore Youth
options.summary: A willing creature you touch drops to 0 Exhaustion and permanently looks 3d10 years younger, never below young adulthood.

summary: A wizard who reshapes matter and energy, crafting a stone of transmutation and changing their own form.
